issues.issue: Whether harassment in Israel amounts to persecution
issues.applicant_position: Neighbours harassed, assaulted and threatened them for not being Jewish; police did not help.
issues.result_text: Cumulative treatment experienced and feared in Israel does not amount to persecution.

issues.issue: Whether the claimants had to use Israeli recourse before claiming refugee protection in Canada
issues.applicant_position: Police complaint and lawyer consultation gave no help; recourse not worth pursuing.
issues.result_text: Claimants did not use available Israeli recourse before leaving; their problems are not persecution.

issues.issue: Whether the claimants face risk to life or cruel treatment if returned to Israel
issues.applicant_position: Fear of further harassment and violence on return to Israel.
issues.result_text: Claimants did not show serious possibility of persecution or risk of torture or death if returned.
